source: YouTube dollar ranges use published RPM bands for that kind of video, applied to 500,000 views in a month. The reel's $/mo figures are Ahmad Salihu's estimates, same formula, not a payout we measured. Instagram has no public per-view rate in India.

niches.about: Why a city was built this way. Maps, satellite shots, voiceover.

niches.name: Car hacks
niches.about: One repair or buying mistake, shown with stock footage and callouts.

niches.name: Survival gear
niches.about: Which piece of gear is worth buying, and which is hype.

niches.about: How one machine works, in animation. Small audience, so the reel's number is low.

niches.name: Animated workouts
niches.about: A workout drawn or animated, no face, counted reps on screen.

niches.name: MMA breakdowns
niches.about: One fight, paused, with the move explained. Footage has to be yours or licensed.

niches.name: Tutorials
niches.about: Screen recording of one job, start to finish. The word is too broad to be one niche.

niches.about: A stick figure walks through one life skill. His other post used a $3.50 RPM on a much bigger channel.

niches.name: Meat
niches.about: Close-up cooking. Cuts, heat, the finished plate. No talking needed.

niches.name: Garden
niches.about: One plant, one problem, a fix. Hands in frame, face optional.

niches.name: Self-defense
niches.about: One situation, three moves. Easy to copy, so the feed is crowded.

niches.name: Celebrities
niches.about: A career or a news week, told with photos and a voice. Rights are the hard part.

niches.name: AI love story
niches.about: A short romance with an AI look and a last-scene turn.

niches.name: Real or AI
niches.about: The viewer has to guess which clip is generated.

niches.name: AI baby comedy
niches.about: One baby, an adult voice, a 30-second joke. Same face every episode.

niches.name: AI mythology
niches.about: One scene from a known story, same art style across episodes.

niches.name: Horror episodes
niches.about: Numbered episodes. A normal start, one wrong detail, a last line.

niches.name: Character dance
niches.about: A still you made, placed on a dance you can use. Same character next time.

niches.name: Money explainers
niches.about: One money idea, whiteboard or stick figures. Highest YouTube RPM band on this page.

niches.name: Case summaries
niches.about: One case, narrated. Ads are often limited, so the RPM band is uneven.

niches.name: One question, three people
niches.about: Instagram format. Ask one question on the street. The third answer is the one people stay for.

niches.name: Get ready with me
niches.about: Instagram format. 0% to 100% on screen. Crowded since October 2026.
